- **Tournaments** (issue #91): single/double-elimination and Swiss-round brackets, invite-only or open registration, across every format -- Traditional, Power Duel (with optional sideboarding, and a decklist now submitted once at signup for the whole event), Grid Draft, and pod-based Booster Draft -- plus a week-later cleanup for finished/cancelled tournaments.
- **Opt-in turn/decision timeouts and full-game time limits** (issue #85): auto-resolve an idle turn or pending decision (including team decisions), a hard per-player time cap for the whole match, a chess-clock time-used indicator, and an idle-turn warning notification.
- **Synchronous mode** (off by default): a live pre-game ready check, a 30-second action timer with banked extensions, a 60-second draft-pick timer, and a shared 30-minute match chess clock covering deck-building/sideboarding time.
- Guile, Regret, and similar "after playing this mood" effects can now be played even when there's no legal target, instead of being blocked outright.
- Fixed a nested-transaction crash that could leave a tournament match stuck "in progress" forever right after its winner's next match tried to start immediately.
- Practice-bot AI fixes: no longer targets itself via a Duplicity-repeated Denial, and never leaves Anger unfilled as its own last card.
- Colorblind-accessible team affiliation shields, a visible Wonder chosen-color display, and a corrected round-level Corruption double-win tracker.
- Sealed Deck now shows as its own plain label everywhere instead of a raw "Draft – sealed_deck" string, and Past games/Import replay got their own dedicated lobby row.
- Every API response is now marked no-store to stop a stale response leaking across sessions, and MySQL/PHP now consistently run on UTC.
